subject.title: fix(agents): load bootstrap files from agentDir alongside workspace

question: Should an explicitly configured `agentDir` become a second bootstrap authority that overrides workspace instructions, or should bootstrap files remain workspace-owned with diagnostics for misplaced files?
rationale: Both outcomes solve the reported silent failure, but enabling overrides changes documented instruction ownership, existing-config upgrade behavior, session identity, and a security-sensitive prompt boundary.

options.title: Keep Workspace Canonical
options.body: Retain workspace-only bootstrap loading and pursue the warning and documentation path represented by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97653.

options.title: Approve Explicit Overrides
options.body: Allow explicitly configured `agentDir` files to override workspace files after adding complete caller coverage, documented precedence, upgrade tests, and live proof.

options.title: Pause Both Paths
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open while designing a clearer per-agent workspace or inheritance contract instead of overloading the runtime-state directory.

recommendation.title: Keep Workspace Canonical
recommendation.body: Retain workspace-only bootstrap loading and pursue the warning and documentation path represented by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97653.

likelyOwner.reason: They performed the closest documented review of workspace bootstrap ownership and its shipped behavior, so they are the best available routing candidate for the authority decision.
